Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is B & H Barber Shop located?
B & H Barber Shop is located at 60 Avenue A, New York, NY 10009, between East 4th and East 5th Streets in the East Village, near Tompkins Square Park. The shop is a short walk from the F train at Lower East Side–2nd Avenue, the L train at 1st Avenue, and the 6 train at Astor Place, making it easy to reach from across the East Village, Alphabet City, and the Lower East Side.
Do I need an appointment, or does B & H Barber Shop take walk-ins?
Walk-ins are welcome every day the shop is open, and online booking is also available for anyone who prefers a set time. Most weekday visits have short waits. Whether you walk in or book ahead, there is no membership or commitment required.
What services does B & H Barber Shop offer?
B & H Barber Shop offers men's haircuts, scissor cuts, buzz cuts, low, mid, high, and skin fades, taper fades, beard trims and line-ups, beard conditioning and coloring, traditional hot towel and straight razor shaves, the royal shave, head shaves, kids' haircuts, and men's hair color. Combination services, such as a haircut with a beard trim or shave, are also available in a single visit.
What are B & H Barber Shop's hours?
B & H Barber Shop is open Monday through Thursday from 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM, Friday from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM, and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. The shop is closed on Saturday. Sunday hours make it one of the East Village barbershops open when many nearby shops are closed for the weekend.
How much does a haircut cost at B & H Barber Shop?
Pricing is posted openly on the website and in the shop, with no hidden fees, and B & H is known as an affordable barbershop for the East Village. The exact cost depends on the service, since a regular haircut, a skin fade, and combination services with a beard trim or shave are priced differently. You always know the price before you sit down.
How long has B & H Barber Shop been in the East Village?
B & H Barber Shop has served the East Village for more than 15 years from its location on Avenue A. Over that time it has built a 4.9-star rating from more than 745 Google reviews, with a base of regular clients from across the East Village, Alphabet City, and the Lower East Side.
Does B & H Barber Shop do kids' haircuts?
Yes. B & H Barber Shop offers patient, kid-friendly haircuts for children of all ages, including first haircuts for toddlers, kids' fades, and teen cuts. Families are welcome, and parents can get their own haircut in the same visit while their child gets theirs.
